本申请提供一种生物基因提取装置，涉及基因提取技术领域。该生物基因提取装置，包括箱体，所述箱体上方设置有用于对生物样本进行研磨的研磨机构，所述箱体内部设置有调节机构，所述调节机构包括连接板和放置盒，所述连接板滑动连接在所述箱体内壁两侧，所述放置盒固定安装在所述连接板上表面并贯穿所述连接板上表面。该生物基因提取装置通过设置有调节机构，解决了以往的生物基因提取装置使用完成后研磨完成的生物样本落至活动板上，难以高效的将生物样本从装置取出，容易导致影响后续基因提取工作效率的问题，实现了能够在研磨完成后便捷的将生物样品从装置取出，能够便于后续基因提取工作进行同时便于对装置清洗的有益效果。

Biological gene extraction deviceTechnical Field

The application relates to the technical field of gene extraction, in particular to a biological gene extraction device.

Background

Gene extraction, also known as genomic DNA extraction, is a process of extracting DNA sequences from organisms, aimed at studying and analyzing the genetic information of the organisms. These DNA molecules contain genetic information of organisms and are blueprints of vital activities.

For example, the utility model discloses a multiple biological gene extraction device disclosed in Chinese patent publication No. CN216296421U, by placing a grinding roller in a box body, clamping a clamping groove on a sleeve into a clamping block, clamping an annular plate into an annular groove, placing a biological sample to be ground in the box body, starting a motor through an external power supply, driving the sleeve to rotate through a rotating shaft by an output shaft of the motor, enabling the sleeve to drive the grinding roller to rotate through a circular shaft, grinding the biological sample by utilizing a first grinding block and a second grinding block, simultaneously driving the first bevel gear to rotate by the rotating shaft, enabling the first bevel gear to mesh with the second bevel gear and driving a transmission shaft to rotate, enabling the transmission shaft to drive a fourth bevel gear to rotate by a movable shaft, enabling the intermittent gear to mesh with a tooth block and driving a movable plate to move downwards, compressing by a spring, and driving the top plate to bounce upwards and enter between the first grinding block and the second grinding block again through spring rebound when the intermittent gear is separated from the tooth block.

In the above-mentioned patent, can grind many times in order to promote extraction efficiency to biological sample, but the device uses the biological sample that the back grinding accomplished to fall to the fly leaf, is difficult to the efficient with biological sample take out from the device, leads to influencing follow-up gene extraction work efficiency easily.

Disclosure of utility model

(One) solving the technical problems

In view of the shortcomings of the prior art, the present application provides a biological gene extraction device that solves the problems mentioned in the background art.

(II) technical scheme

The biological gene extraction device comprises a box body, wherein a grinding mechanism for grinding biological samples is arranged above the box body, an adjusting mechanism is arranged in the box body, the adjusting mechanism comprises a connecting plate and placing boxes, the connecting plate is connected to two sides of the inner wall of the box body in a sliding mode, and the placing boxes are fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the connecting plate and penetrate through the upper surface of the connecting plate.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, can pass through connecting rod, grinding piece, axis of rotation, belt and motor's cooperation through grinding mechanism and use, make all grinding pieces can rotate simultaneously and grind biological sample, can grind the multiunit sample simultaneously and ensure that all samples all pass through the same processing condition and operation procedure to the experimental error that leads to because of the operation difference has been reduced. Can be convenient after the grinding is accomplished take out biological sample follow-up device through adjustment mechanism, can be convenient for follow-up gene extraction work go on the while be convenient for wash the device.

Preferably, the surface of the inner wall of the box body is connected with a positioning block in a sliding manner, and the upper surface of the positioning block is fixedly provided with a box cover.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, can avoid its production to rock to the case lid spacing when the device uses through the locating piece.

Preferably, the lower surface of the box cover is rotationally connected with a connecting rod, one end of the connecting rod is fixedly provided with a grinding block, the bottom end of the inner wall of the box body is rotationally connected with a rotating shaft, and the connecting rod is fixedly connected with the rotating shaft.

By adopting the technical scheme, the biological sample can be ground by rotating the grinding block.

Preferably, the surface of the rotating shaft is slidably connected with a belt, a motor is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the box cover, and an output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with the rotating shaft.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, can drive the axis of rotation through the motor and rotate and then drive the grinding piece and rotate.

Preferably, the electric telescopic rod is fixedly arranged on the lower surface of the box cover, and a pressing plate is fixedly arranged at one end of the electric telescopic rod.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, can be through electric telescopic handle and clamp plate to the connecting plate spacing.

Preferably, the bottom end of the inner wall of the box body is fixedly provided with a second electric telescopic rod, and one end of the second electric telescopic rod is fixedly provided with a top plate.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, can make the inside biological sample distribution of box evenly in order to grind many times through falling behind No. two electric telescopic handle and roof jack-up the connecting plate.

(III) beneficial effects

The application provides a biological gene extraction device. The beneficial effects are as follows:

1. This biological gene extraction device is through being provided with adjustment mechanism, has solved biological gene extraction device in the past and has used the biological sample that the back was accomplished to grind to fall to the fly leaf on, is difficult to the efficient take out biological sample from the device, leads to influencing follow-up gene extraction work efficiency's problem easily, has realized can be after grind the completion convenient take out biological sample from the device, can be convenient for follow-up gene extraction work go on the beneficial effect of being convenient for simultaneously to device abluent.

2. This biological gene extraction device is through being provided with grinding mechanism, uses through the cooperation of connecting rod, abrasive brick, axis of rotation, belt and motor, makes all abrasive bricks can rotate simultaneously and grinds biological sample, has realized can grind the multiunit sample simultaneously and ensure that all samples all pass through the same processing condition and operation procedure to reduce the beneficial effect of experimental error because of the operation difference leads to.

Drawings

In order to more clearly illustrate the embodiments of the utility model or the technical solutions in the prior art, the drawings which are used in the description of the embodiments or the prior art will be briefly described, it being obvious that the drawings in the description below are only some embodiments of the utility model, and that other drawings can be obtained from them without inventive faculty for a person skilled in the art.

FIG. 1 is a schematic view of the front view of the present application;

FIG. 2 is a schematic view of the internal structure of the case of the present application;

FIG. 3 is a schematic view of a polishing mechanism according to the present application;

Fig. 4 is a schematic view of the internal structure of the case cover of the present application.

The device comprises a box body 1, a grinding mechanism 2, a box cover 201, a positioning block 202, a positioning block 203, a connecting rod 204, a grinding block 205, a rotating shaft 206, a belt 207, a motor 3, an adjusting mechanism 301, a connecting plate 302, a placing box 303, a first electric telescopic rod 304, a pressing plate 305, a second electric telescopic rod 306 and a top plate.

Detailed Description

It should be noted that, in the description of the embodiments of the present application, the terms "front, rear", "left, right", "upper, lower", and the like indicate an azimuth or a positional relationship based on the azimuth or the positional relationship shown in the drawings, and are merely for convenience of describing the present application and simplifying the description, and do not indicate or imply that the apparatus or element to be referred to must have a specific azimuth, be configured and operated in a specific azimuth, and thus should not be construed as limiting the present application. The terms "mounted," "connected," "coupled," and "connected" are to be construed broadly, and may be, for example, fixedly connected, detachably connected, or integrally connected, or may be directly connected, or may be indirectly connected through an intermediate medium, or may be in communication with the inside of two elements. The specific meaning of the above terms in the present application will be understood in specific cases by those of ordinary skill in the art.

The application is further illustrated by the figures and examples.

Referring to fig. 1 and 2, the embodiment of the application provides a biological gene extraction device, which comprises a box body 1, a grinding mechanism 2 for grinding biological samples is arranged above the box body 1, an adjusting mechanism 3 is arranged inside the box body 1, the adjusting mechanism 3 comprises a connecting plate 301 and a placing box 302, the connecting plate 301 is connected to two sides of the inner wall of the box body 1 in a sliding manner, the placing box 302 is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the connecting plate 301 and penetrates through the upper surface of the connecting plate 301, the grinding mechanism 2 can retract and stretch the electric telescopic rod 303 and the electric telescopic rod 305 respectively to reduce the distance between the bottom end of the inner wall of the placing box 302 and a grinding block 204, after primary grinding is completed, the electric telescopic rod 305 is started to retract and stretch the connecting plate 301 and the placing box 302, the biological samples are evenly distributed and then are continuously ground for the second time by the grinding block 204, the connecting plate 301 and the placing box 302 are pulled out of the device after the box cover 201 is taken down, the biological samples are poured out of the device and the placing box 302, the placing box 205 is cleaned by the electric telescopic rod 303, the electric telescopic rod 303 is started to enable the electric telescopic rod 205 to rotate a plurality of groups of connecting plates 205 and the connecting plates 207 to rotate, and the connecting plate 207 are simultaneously driven by the electric telescopic rod 203 to rotate the rotating the connecting plate 207 and the box body 1, and the rotating shafts 207 are simultaneously, and the rotating shafts 207 are driven by the rotating shafts 207.

Referring to fig. 3 and 4, in an aspect of the present embodiment, a positioning block 202 is slidably coupled to an inner wall surface of the case 1, and a case cover 201 is fixedly mounted on an upper surface of the positioning block 202.

The lower surface of the box cover 201 is rotationally connected with a connecting rod 203, one end of the connecting rod 203 is fixedly provided with a grinding block 204, the bottom end of the inner wall of the box body 1 is rotationally connected with a rotating shaft 205, and the connecting rod 203 is fixedly connected with the rotating shaft 205.

The surface sliding connection of axis of rotation 205 has belt 206, surface fixed mounting has motor 207 on case lid 201, motor 207 output shaft and axis of rotation 205 fixed connection, make it retract respectively and stretch through starting electric telescopic handle 303 and electric telescopic handle 305 No. two make the distance of placing box 302 inner wall bottom and abrasive brick 204 reduce and carry out more effective grinding to biological sample, after first grinding is accomplished, start electric telescopic handle 305 and make it retract the back stretch and make connecting plate 301 and place box 302 fall back after the back lift make place box inside biological sample distribute evenly and continue to carry out secondary grinding by abrasive brick 204 to biological sample, take off the device with case lid 201 and take out its and place box 302 from the device and take out biological sample and wash place box 302.

Referring to fig. 1 and 2, in an aspect of the present embodiment, a first electric telescopic rod 303 is fixedly mounted on a lower surface of a case cover 201, and a pressing plate 304 is fixedly mounted on one end of the first electric telescopic rod 303.

The bottom end of the inner wall of the box body 1 is fixedly provided with a second electric telescopic rod 305, one end of the second electric telescopic rod 305 is fixedly provided with a top plate 306, the box cover 201 is covered above the box body 1 by sliding the positioning block 202 into the inner wall of the box body 1, meanwhile, the first electric telescopic rod 303 and the pressing plate 304 compress the connecting plate 301 to limit the connecting plate 301, then the motor 207 is started, the motor 207 drives the rotating shaft 205 to rotate so that the belt 206 rotates, and all the rotating shafts 205 simultaneously rotate so that the connecting rod 203 and the grinding block 204 are driven to rotate to grind a plurality of groups of biological samples simultaneously.

All the electric equipment in this scheme all carry out the power supply through external power supply.

When the device is used, the device is placed at a designated position, biological samples are placed in the placing box 302 and then placed in the box 1, the positioning block 202 is slid into the inner wall of the box 1 to enable the box cover 201 to be covered above the box 1, meanwhile, the first electric telescopic rod 303 and the pressing plate 304 are pressed against the connecting plate 301 to limit the biological samples, then the motor 207 is started, the motor 207 drives the rotating shaft 205 to rotate so as to enable the belt 206 to rotate all the rotating shafts 205 to drive the connecting rod 203 and the grinding block 204 to rotate so as to grind a plurality of groups of biological samples simultaneously, the first electric telescopic rod 303 and the second electric telescopic rod 305 are started in the grinding process to retract and stretch respectively so as to enable the distance between the bottom end of the inner wall of the placing box 302 and the grinding block 204 to be reduced so as to grind the biological samples more effectively, after the primary grinding is completed, the second electric telescopic rod 305 is started to retract so as to enable the connecting plate 301 and the placing box 302 to be lifted back after the biological samples in the placing box are uniformly distributed, the grinding block 204 is continued to grind the biological samples secondarily, and the box cover 201 is pulled out of the device after the grinding process, and the box cover 201 is pulled out of the device so that the device can be cleaned and the placing box 302.

It is noted that relational terms such as first and second, and the like are used solely to distinguish one entity or action from another entity or action without necessarily requiring or implying any actual such relationship or order between such entities or actions.
